query:
SELECT id, touchKey,
  (CASE WHEN bodyText LIKE '%tmatkd.com/camp%' AND bodyText NOT LIKE '%tmatkd.com/camp-registration%' THEN 'STILL_BAD' 
        WHEN bodyHtml LIKE '%tmatkd.com/camp%' AND bodyHtml NOT LIKE '%tmatkd.com/camp-registration%' THEN 'STILL_BAD'
        WHEN bodyText LIKE '%tmatkd.com/camp-registration%' OR bodyHtml LIKE '%tmatkd.com/camp-registration%' THEN 'FIXED'
        ELSE 'no_camp_url' END) AS url_status
FROM sequenceTemplates
WHERE sequenceKey = 'summer_camp_nurture'
ORDER BY id;
